text:
Element X is in Group II of the Periodic Table.
Which statements about X are correct?
1
X is a metal.
2
X has two electrons in its outer shell.
3
X is a liquid at room temperature.
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
